description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the MembershipAPI class in the OrangeHRM HR management system. It tests CRUD operations (getAll, getOne, create, update, delete) for the Membership API endpoints using mock services and data providers, verifying the API's behavior under various scenarios.

classes.name: MembershipAPITest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the MembershipAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It inherits from EndpointIntegrationTestCase and includes multiple test methods for API operations.
